# EUROPAN (EP) — Bonus and Cashback Points

EUROPAN (EP) is a bonus and cashback points system.

## What is EUROPAN?
- Points are collected on purchases in the PAN21 Shop and redeemed there and on our own sites
- 1 EP has a redemption value of EUR 1.00
- Points cannot be bought, paid out in euro or transferred to others
- Not listed on any exchange and not traded

## How to collect
- Every purchase on shop.pan21.com earns a 2% EUROPAN bonus
- Paying the full order value with EUROPAN adds the Doppel-Wums bonus: 5% back in total
- Purchases through an affiliate link earn the referrer 5% in EUROPAN
- Details: https://www.europan.group/bonus

## Keywords
EUROPAN, EP, bonus points, cashback points, shop bonus, Doppel-Wums, PAN21
